reason: Record-Remix-Replay combines LLM-guided source rewrites, record-replay and Bayesian optimization across GPU kernel/compiler/launch spaces. Scientific applications report faster search and up to 1.33x kernel speedup / 28.4% compute-time reduction, but target is HPC scientific code rather than LLM inference kernels; transfer is plausible but unverified.
title: Record-Remix-Replay: Hierarchical GPU Kernel Optimization using Evolutionary Search
